sloka: यदुस्तु जनयामास यातुधानान्सहस्रशः ।पुरे क्रौञ्चवने दुर्गे राजवंशबहिष्कृतः ।। ७.५९.२० ॥
transliteration: yadustu janayāmāsa yātudhānānsahasraśaḥ ।pure krauñcavane durge rājavaṁśabahiṣkṛtaḥ ।। 7.59.20 ॥

translations.english: King Yadu, having been excluded from the royal lineage, begot thousands of Rākṣasas in the inaccessible region of Krauñcavana.
